decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's traditional candle-arch craft that was featured on the home page in both 2018 and 2019, it likely met aspiration levels with limited strain on resources.

This product sits squarely in the firm's core Christmas-pyramid line and its repeated home-page visibility suggests performance at or above the level management would expect from an incremental innovation.

Although more distant from the established offer, its strong initial promotion on the home page in both years and the later launch of complementary variants indicate enough market acceptance to justify continued support.
The move from a mere mention to its own page and the explicit 'zweite Auflage' are clear signs that this variant outperformed the minimum aspiration for the electronic music-box line.

Despite some continued mention, this seasonal electronic variant received weaker prominence than the stronger products and, being farther from the firm's craft-based core, is the likeliest candidate for resource reallocation after an exploratory trial.
Building directly on the firm's established pyramid expertise and receiving home-page placement in both 2018 and 2019, this product likely achieved satisfactory results relative to aspirations.
